summary: PR 1892 fixes the reproduced non-streaming HTTP passthrough and the empty-string reasoning_content counterexample, and adds gRPC prefilled-thinking initialization. It remains a partial fix because HTTP streaming explicitly bypasses reasoning parsing and forwards worker SSE bytes unchanged.
